digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation classification and recovery messaging
propositions: When attestation write fails with sidecar_emitted=False, sign-review cannot recover but current guidance incorrectly recommends it
The catch-all failure branch in classify_plan_review_attestation does not inspect sidecar_emitted despite it being present on the result dict
When sidecar is lost, the recorded verdict silently remains from the previous round and is contradictory and stale
A new ATTESTATION_SIDECAR_LOST cause must discriminate sign failures with missing sidecar and direct to review-plan recovery instead of sign-review
The recovery guidance must state that no PASS record persisted and that the recorded verdict is from a prior round
